Message:
“You were really
pushing your luck this time.”

With the Curse dispelled
and the city bustling with
the excitement of a festival,
I’d remained in Elaine’s care,
receiving treatment.

Elaine is a nun who serves
our angel lord Samyaza.
Through her words of prayer,
the pain coursing through my body
gradually began to dissipate.

“Even if you save the world,
it’ll mean nothing if you
just end up cold on the ground,
you know.”

“I’m sorry,
I just couldn’t help myself.
But, you know I’m only happy
when everyone else is happy.”

The city left on the brink of ruin
just yesterday was now
brimming with a carefree air
of joy and celebration.

Morgana and Artoria
had dragged Myrlennia out
to the festival with them.

The Hero of the Staff and the
Hero of the Lance were quick to
follow after, and I couldn’t help
but smile at the sight of
everyone enjoying themselves.

“You know,
the Hero of the Lance
won’t be very pleased
if you keep doing this.”

“Wh-What does he
have to do with anything...?!”

As if amused by my outburst,
Elaine just smirked.

“In any case, no more
reckless stunts, okay?

Don’t just keep the Hero of the
Lance in mind—there’s also
Myrlennia...and me too, of course.

We’d be heartbroken
if we lost you.
We’re family, remember?”
“I’m sorry...”

Elaine had never scolded me
like this before.

But she was right.
I really do have
a wonderful family by my side.
I can’t let myself forget that.

“Look at that big smile
on your face.
Do you really feel ‘sorry’?”
“O-Of course I do...!”
